Your holdings: SOXL (-56.11%), MUU (-30.63%), and SPAL (-35.9%) are leveraged ETFs with deep losses and are marked SELL. SMCI (-26.85%) is also a significant concern. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on any further developments in US-China tech relations and how the market reacts to upcoming housing and employment data.

Bottom line: With significant losses in leveraged positions and mixed tech sentiment, focus on aggressive risk management and protecting capital.
plays: Review stops on deeply underwater leveraged ETFs like SOXL, MUU, and SPAL; consider trimming to reduce risk.
SMH is a TRIM and near its stop at 540; be ready to act if it breaks that level.
No new buys today - hold and watch for clearer signals in your concentrated tech sector.
